programmes.t: My Haunted House: The Attic and 'Til Death
programmes.d: A college student is tormented by her little sister's imaginary friend. A newly engaged woman sees visions of her fiance's widow.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Boy in the Closet
programmes.d: A couple is haunted by the spirit of a little boy who lives in their young son's bedroom closet. A gas station owner's life is abruptly changed by the appearance of a mysterious paranormal mist with a demonic presence.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: Screams in the Dark
programmes.d: Two men retire without knowing their new home sits on the graves of people who were tortured and murdered by the KKK. The Queen Mary once ruled the high seas, but now ghosts roam her decks.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Face in the Window
programmes.d: A woman under assault by an aggressive entity is rescued by the spirit of her deceased son. A maid who was murdered in the 19th century continues to work at an old Texas hotel.

programmes.t: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Haunted Bergen House
programmes.d: With the help of ghost hunter Megan Deputy, Nick investigates the Haunted Bergen House.

programmes.t: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Fire in the Church
programmes.d: Nick tries to determine if the ghosts of priests that died in a 1948 fire are haunting the property today.

programmes.t: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Mountain Clinic
programmes.d: Nick conducts the first-ever paranormal investigation of the Mountain Clinic, a 105-year-old vacant hospital.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Spirits at The Lord Eldon
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team travels to the old town of Knutsford, Cheshire to investigate the historic Lord Eldon Inn, hoping to contact the spirit of Sarah Ann Pollitt who is said to haunt the pub.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Monks and Demons at The Rutland Arms Hotel
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team journeys to Nottingham and the historic Rutland Arms Hotel. The pub and hotel have seen several centuries of change, and with that change came tragedy.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Final Session at Galleries of Justice
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team travel back in time to The Galleries of Justice in Nottingham. This was a one stop shop for justice where criminals were held awaiting trial.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Underground World Of The City of Caves
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team ventures underground to investigate the City of Caves in Nottingham.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Strange Killing of Ken Rex McElroy
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane explore the gripping tale of justice, mystery and community in Ken Rex McElroy's demise.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Scandalous Murder of William Desmond Taylor
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane untangle a web of Hollywood's secrets in the scandalous murder of William Desmond Taylor.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Extraordinary Disappearance of Louis Le Prince
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane cover the disappearance of a man who stepped onto a train only to never be seen again.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Disturbing Mystery of the Jamison Family
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane discuss the mystery of the Jamison family, who vanished in the woods under odd circumstances.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Sinister Disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa
programmes.d: Delve into the case of Jimmy Hoffa as Ryan and Shane investigate the mystery of this prominent mob figure.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Bizarre Collar Bomb Bank Robbery
programmes.d: Join Ryan and Shane as they discuss the bizarre collar bomb incident and the details that still remain murky.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Death of the Eight-Day Bride / The Incredible Alcatraz Prison Break
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane unravel the tale of a tragic love triangle and cover a thrilling escape from Alcatraz Prison.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Nene Leakes
programmes.d: TV personality and "The Real Housewives of Atlanta" star NeNe Leakes joins psychic medium Kim Russo to investigate paranormal events connected to a wedding she attended in Atlanta, GA.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Kelly Osbourne
programmes.d: Kelly Osbourne enlists psychic medium Kim Russo to help her solve a series of paranormal mysteries she experienced at a notoriously haunted Hollywood hotel.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Taye Diggs
programmes.d: Taye Diggs returns to a New York City theatre with psychic medium Kim Russo to investigate an unforgettable paranormal encounter he experienced years ago.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Pilot-UFO Disclosure
programmes.d: Richard examines the growing UFO Disclosure movement and its attempts to force the US Government to reveal to the public what it knows about UFOs and aliens.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: 9/11: Controlled Demolition
programmes.d: Richard speaks with the founders of Architects and Engineers for 911 Truth and Firefighters for 911 Truth who present their case that the WTC towers were brought down by controlled demolition on 9/11.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programmes.d: An investigation into the practice of past-life regression therapy; a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover memories of supposed past lives.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Chemtrails
programmes.d: What on Earth are they spraying? Richard travels into the field to meet several researchers who present compelling evidence that chemicals or biological agents are being deliberately sprayed into the atmosphere by some shadowy government agency.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Antichrist
programmes.d: End times prophecy experts discuss the possible identity of the antichrist and the timing of his emergence onto the world state.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Electronic Harassment
programmes.d: Two victims of alleged electronic harassment and organized gang-stalking recount their horrible ordeals. Richard investigates possible theories as to who is behind this program and why.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Demonic Possession
programmes.d: The religious practice known as exorcism is examined as well as claims of demonic possession. Richard travels to a Catholic seminary in Yonkers, New York.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programmes.d: Is a powerfully rich cabal with a globalist agenda conspiring to destroy sovereign nations and impose authoritarian rule?

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programmes.d: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programmes.d: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: The Block
programmes.d: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: The Nursery and The Closet
programmes.d: A dangerous entity stalks a pregnant woman in her new house. A single mother discovers a terrifying secret trapped in her son's closet. The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Unwanted Guest and Mirror Image
programmes.d: A dangerous poltergeist threatens a newly-blended family. A young woman is tormented by visions of her own gruesome death.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Trapped and Retreat
programmes.d: Paranormal activity threatens a young nurse caring for a catatonic patient. A young couple falls prey to a demonic presence in a remote cabin.
